name: mosaic-token-extensions-admin
description: TypeScript SDK, CLI, and UI for managing standard token types on Solana (ex: Stablecoin & Arcade Tokens)

scripts.precommit: pnpm run format && pnpm run lint:fix
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run type-check

author: Solana Foundation

pnpm._dependencyNotes: @solana-program/token-2022 is pinned to the PUBLISHED 0.18.0 (no tarball, no patch). The FLOOR for confidential mint/burn is 0.15.0, the first release carrying the upstreamed InstructionPlan helpers (getConfidentialMintInstructionPlan / getConfidentialBurnInstructionPlan / getPermissionedConfidentialBurnInstructionPlan / getUpdateConfidentialMintBurnDecryptableSupplyInstructionFromSupply) from https://github.com/solana-program/token-2022/pull/1357 (shipped 2026-08-13) — 0.13.0 and 0.14.x do NOT have them. Mosaic's mint.ts/burn.ts/supply.ts delegate straight to @solana-program/token-2022/confidential. NOTE: confidentialTransferHelpers.d.ts is BYTE-IDENTICAL between 0.15.0 and 0.18.0, so 0.16-0.18 added no confidential mint/burn API; the move to 0.18.0 was made to stay current with the @solana-program/* ecosystem, which has migrated to Solana Kit v8 wholesale. KIT V8: 0.16.0 is where token-2022 moved its peers to @solana/kit ^8 and @solana/sysvars ^8, which is why the whole monorepo moved with it. The v7->v8 removed-API surface is effectively nil for this repo, verified by diffing published typings 7.1.1 -> 8.3.0: kit's only removed top-level module is compute-unit-limit-estimation (superseded by resource-limit-estimation, which is identical in v7 and v8) and this repo uses no CU-estimation API; across @solana/{codecs,signers,transactions,transaction-messages,accounts,addresses,keys,rpc,rpc-types,errors,instructions,programs} the only removed exports are TRANSACTION_PACKET_HEADER / TRANSACTION_PACKET_SIZE / TRANSACTION_SIZE_LIMIT, all unused here. @solana/instruction-plans' v8 breaking changes are all EXECUTOR-side (the deprecated createTransactionPlanExecutor overload returning Signature|Transaction is gone, BaseTransactionPlanResultContext is gone, and the default TContext became TransactionPlanResultContextWithSignature); this repo never builds an executor — confidential/plan.ts uses only createTransactionPlanner, which is unchanged. @solana-program/zk-elgamal-proof moved to ^0.4.0 (kit ^8 peer); it has ZERO added or removed exports vs 0.3.2, so every symbol confidential/proof.ts imports still exists. @solana-program/system is on its kit-v8-native release (0.14.1); @solana-program/memo is pinned to 0.13.1 rather than the newer 0.14.x, because 0.14.0 repointed MEMO_PROGRAM_ADDRESS to the Pinocchio Memo v4 program, which solana-test-validator 2.2.20 does not ship — see packages/sdk/package.json `_dependencyNotes` for the full reasoning. @solana/token-acl-sdk@0.4.0 declares an exact token-2022 0.12.0 dependency; the override forces it up to 0.18.0 — safe because it only consumes stable core exports (TOKEN_2022_PROGRAM_ADDRESS, getMintDecoder, ATA/metadata helpers, AccountState, Mint), unchanged across 0.10-0.18. @solana/token-acl-sdk / @solana/token-acl-gate-sdk / @solana/connector declare kit <=7 ranges but are forced onto v8 via the @solana/kit + @solana/* overrides. This was validated by scanning their INSTALLED dist/ for every API v8 removed or tightened (getUnionCodec, getDiscriminatedUnionCodec, ReactiveStreamStore, createTransactionPlanExecutor, BaseTransactionPlanResultContext, TRANSACTION_SIZE_LIMIT, TRANSACTION_PACKET_SIZE, the CU-estimation factories): zero hits in all three. Note @solana/connector declares a HARD kit dependency (not a peer) and has been running two majors ahead of its declared range under these overrides for some time, so forcing it one major further is a smaller jump than the one already proven here. Because pnpm overrides are global and apps/app imports @solana/mosaic-sdk, kit must resolve to a single version tree-wide — this is all-or-nothing, not stageable per workspace. NO PATCHES: nothing in this repo is `pnpm patch`ed any more. Historically @solana/zk-sdk WAS patched (through 0.5.1) to make its ./bundler subpath condition-aware, because token-2022's confidential.mjs hardcodes `@solana/zk-sdk/bundler` (the ESM+wasm bundler build) which can't load under Node (`Unknown file extension .wasm`) and, if forced, yields a dual-WASM `expected instance of ElGamalKeypair` mismatch. That hardcoded /bundler import is STILL present in 0.18.0. @solana/zk-sdk 0.5.2 ships the fix upstream — https://github.com/solana-program/zk-elgamal-proof/pull/519 added a `node` condition on ./bundler plus a condition-aware root `.` export. The zk-sdk override REMAINS pinned EXACTLY (0.5.2, not ^0.5.2): it guarantees exactly ONE resolved zk-sdk copy across the tree, and a second copy reintroduces the dual-WASM class-identity mismatch. DO NOT move to 0.5.3 casually: it has an identical API surface and an identical exports map, but REBUILT WASM binaries (index_bg.wasm differs in all of dist/node, dist/bundler and dist/web), unlike the 0.5.1 -> 0.5.2 release which was byte-identical dist and packaging metadata only. There is nothing to gain from it and it is a real rebuild of the crypto layer; token-2022 0.18.0 peers @solana/zk-sdk ^0.5.1, which 0.5.2 satisfies. NOTE: packages/sdk/src/confidential/_zk.{node,browser}.ts and the `./_zk` export in packages/sdk/package.json are NOT workarounds and must stay — they are Mosaic's own deliberate build-selection indirection. Confidential key derivation (packages/sdk/src/confidential/keys.ts) is wallet-only as of HOO-1595: `ConfidentialKeys.signerMessage(new Uint8Array(0))` / `fromSignature`, one signature, no owner/mint/token-account seed — this is why @solana/zk-sdk needed to reach 0.5.x in the first place. See packages/sdk/package.json `_dependencyNotes`.
